$comment: liveSuite.runner (#783) is the ONE command that runs an SDK's live wire-cases: it always goes through the harness wrapper (`--corpus-seed --exec -- <cmd>`), which boots the harness, exports CONFEATURE_LIVE=1 + LIVE_HARNESS_URL and passes the exit code through — so no caller can run a live suite that silently skips. contract-live.yml runs it; dagger livePythonContract reads python's from here. Single source of truth for per-SDK containerized test coverage (spec 053 Phase 5, #204). Consumed by .github/workflows/release-gate.yml and .github/workflows/sdk-publish.yml. status=covered SDKs run their daggerFn as a publish/release gate; status=pending SDKs BLOCK publish (no false-green); status=exempt SDKs publish without a gate (documented reason). Flip a pending entry to covered (with its daggerFn) when epic #354 containerizes it — both gates auto-enroll it with zero workflow edits. localGate (default true when absent): whether the SDK also runs in the LOCAL prepushAll suite. Tier-2 SDKs (java/dotnet/php/ruby/rust/dart) are covered but localGate=false — release-gate-only — because 6 heavyweight heterogeneous toolchain containers in parallel exceed the NFR-004 8GB local budget (they OOM the Dagger engine); this is the constitution v1.3.0 'demote the slowest tier to release-gate-only' clause. The release-gate runs each on its own CI runner, so no shared-memory OOM. android + kotlin-mp (#364) are also localGate=false: their shared androidSdkContainer is pinned to linux/amd64 because AGP ships only an x86-64 aapt2 (no linux-aarch64 build), so on an arm64 host it runs under emulation — too slow for prepushAll, fine for the release gate.

liveSuite.runner: node tools/test-harness-live-contract/dist/cli.js --corpus-seed --exec -- pnpm --filter @confeature/sdk-node exec vp test run tests/wire/wire-cases.live.test.ts tests/wire/configcat-stock.live.test.ts
node tools/test-harness-live-contract/dist/cli.js --corpus-seed --exec -- bash -c 'cd apps/sdk-python && uv run pytest tests/wire/test_wire_cases_live.py tests/wire/test_configcat_stock_live.py -q'
